# Notation

Notation styles Obsidian after Notion, adapting Notion-like typography, spacing and layout to Markdown notes. The recorded description describes the result as a calmer, more readable workspace built from subtle UI tweaks and familiar Notion visuals.

![Notation screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deathau/Notation-for-Obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Notation"
    author: "deathau"
    repo:   "deathau/Notation-for-Obsidian"
    slug:   "notation"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/notation"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/deathau/Notation-for-Obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deathau/Notation-for-Obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Style Obsidian with a Notion-inspired interface that adapts Notion-like typography, spacing, and layout for your markdown notes. Create a calmer, more readable workspace with subtle UI tweaks and familiar Notion visuals."
}
```
